questions.stem: A shopkeeper sells an article for Rs. \(480\) and incurs a loss of \(20\%\). At what price should he sell the article to gain \(25\%\) profit?
questions.keySolution:
Step 1: Find Cost Price (CP)
Selling Price = Rs. \(480\), Loss = \(20\%\)
\(SP = CP - Loss\)
\(480 = CP - 0.20 \times CP = 0.80 \times CP\)
\(CP = \frac{480}{0.80} = Rs. 600\)

Step 2: Find new selling price for \(25\%\) profit
\(New SP = CP + 0.25 \times CP = 1.25 \times 600 = Rs. 750\)

questions.stem: An article is sold for Rs. \(1200\) at a profit of \(20\%\). If the shopkeeper wants to make a loss of \(10\%\), what should be the selling price?
questions.keySolution:
Step 1: Find Cost Price
\(SP = Rs. 1200\), Profit = \(20\%\)
\(SP = CP + 0.20 \times CP = 1.20 \times CP\)
\(1200 = 1.20 \times CP\)
\(CP = \frac{1200}{1.20} = Rs. 1000\)

Step 2: Find selling price for \(10\%\) loss
\(New SP = CP - 0.10 \times CP = 0.90 \times 1000 = Rs. 900\)
